posts.title: Finished reading: Stoner by John Williams 📚
posts.description: Finished reading: Stoner by John Williams 📚 ★★★★★ Literary Fiction Ebook Own This is a beautiful, deeply moving story about a man’s life. It will make you smile, wince, and feel sad—but above all, it will make you think about William Stoner’s life and your own. I will return to this book.
